system.description: You touch a pile of raw materials (stone, metal, wood) and reorganise them over 12 hours.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the result is a masterwork that sells for twice its worth.
outcomes.success: The materials become a complex, non-living machine or a massive, masterwork statue of your choosing.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time is lost and the materials are scrap.
outcomes.ruin: The thing you made has a will of its own and resents you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
